Cancer magister.name: Metacarcinus magister
Cancer magister.why: Genus changed since 2004. ASFIS lists Dungeness crab as Metacarcinus magister (DUN).

Paralithodes camtschatica.name: Paralithodes camtschaticus
Paralithodes camtschatica.why: Spelling. ASFIS lists red king crab as Paralithodes camtschaticus (KCD).

Lithodes aequispina.name: Lithodes aequispinus
Lithodes aequispina.why: Spelling. ASFIS lists golden king crab as Lithodes aequispinus (KAQ).

Octopus dofleini.name: Enteroctopus dofleini
Octopus dofleini.why: Genus changed. ASFIS lists North Pacific giant octopus as Enteroctopus dofleini (OQF).

Theragra chalcogramma.name: Gadus chalcogrammus
Theragra chalcogramma.why: Genus changed. ASFIS lists Alaska (walleye) pollock as Gadus chalcogrammus (ALK).

Clupea harengus pallasi.name: Clupea pallasii
Clupea harengus pallasi.why: Now a full species. ASFIS lists Pacific herring as Clupea pallasii (HEP).

Lampetra tridentata.name: Entosphenus tridentatus
Lampetra tridentata.why: Genus changed. ASFIS lists Pacific lamprey as Entosphenus tridentatus (LAO).

Sebastes altivelis.name: Sebastolobus altivelis
Sebastes altivelis.why: The bulletin prints the wrong genus. Thornyheads are Sebastolobus; ASFIS lists longspine thornyhead as Sebastolobus altivelis (SJZ).

Sebastes prorigor.name: Sebastes proriger
Sebastes prorigor.why: Misprint in the bulletin. ASFIS lists redstripe rockfish as Sebastes proriger (RPJ).

Notorynchus maculata.name: Notorynchus cepedianus
Notorynchus maculata.why: Old name. ASFIS lists broadnose sevengill shark as Notorynchus cepedianus (NTC).

Galeorhinus zyopterus.name: Galeorhinus galeus
Galeorhinus zyopterus.why: Old name. Soupfin is the tope shark; ASFIS lists it as Galeorhinus galeus (GAG).

Limanda proboscidea.name: Myzopsetta proboscidea
Limanda proboscidea.why: Genus changed. ASFIS lists longhead dab as Myzopsetta proboscidea (EOR).

Panope sp..name: Panopea sp.
Panope sp..why: Spelling of the genus. ASFIS lists geoducks at genus level as Panopea spp (GEX).
